Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
Aaron_1: brother of Moses (Exodus 4:14) and Levitical priest (Exodus 28:1)
Elizaphan_1: the leader of the tribe of Zebulun (Numbers 34:25) to apportion the Land (Numbers 34:17)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Joel_1: firstborn of Samuel (1 Samuel 8:2, 1 Chronicles 6:28, 1 Chronicles 6:33)
Saul_1: son of Kish (1 Samuel 9:2), King of Israel (1 Samuel 11:15)
Michal_1: daughter of Saul (1 Samuel 14:49) and barren (2 Samuel 6:23) wife of King David (1 Samuel 18:27)
Abiathar_1: son of Ahimelech, the priest (1 Samuel 22:20), counselor to David (1 Chronicles 27:34)
Obed-edom_1: the Gittite in whose house the ark of the covenant rested (2 Samuel 6:10)
Zadok_3: (grand)son of Ahitub and father of Shallum (1 Chronicles 6:12)
Uriel_1: son of Tahath (1 Chronicles 6:24), chief of the sons of Kohath (1 Chronicles 15:5)
Elkanah_4: father of Amasai and Ahimoth (1 Chronicles 6:25) and son of Joel (1 Chronicles 6:36)
Asaiah_3: son of Haggiah (1 Chronicles 6:30), chief of the sons of Merari (1 Chronicles 15:6)
Heman_2: the singer, son of Joel_1, decendant of Kohath (1 Chronicles 6:33), father of fourteen sons and three daughter (1 Chronicles 25:5)
Asaph_2: son of Berechiah (1 Chronicles 6:39), chosen first by lot (1 Chronicles 25:9)
Joel_6: chief of the sons of Gershom (1 Chronicles 15:7), son of Ladan (1 Chronicles 23:8)
Shemaiah_7: chief of the sons of Elizaphan (1 Chronicles 15:8)
Eliel_7: chief of the sons of Hebron (1 Chronicles 15:9)
Amminadab_2: chief of the sons of Uzziel (1 Chronicles 15:10)
Zechariah_5: second rank Levite, gatekeeper (1 Chronicles 15:18), a trumpeter (1 Chronicles 15:24)
Jehiel_1: second rank Levite, gatekeeper (1 Chronicles 15:18), son of Ladan [Libni_1] (1 Chronicles 23:8)
Benaiah_4: second rank Levite, gatekeeper (1 Chronicles 15:18), a trumpeter (1 Chronicles 15:24)
Obed-edom_2: second rank Levite, gatekeeper (1 Chronicles 15:18), the south gate (1 Chronicles 26:15)
Chenaniah_1: chief of the Levites (1 Chronicles 15:22), descendant of Izhar (1 Chronicles 26:29)
Jehiah_1: one of the gatekeepers for the ark (1 Chronicles 15:23)
